# `passportsim inspect`

Read the guest's tasks, heap, NVS, LVGL objects and fidelity table.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_inspect` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/inspect` |
| Scenario step | `inspect.expect` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `read_only`, `idempotent`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim inspect <what> [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--nvs-values] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `nvs_values` | `--nvs-values` | `boolean` | no | Show non-credential NVS values (false). |
| `vars` | carried by `--json` | `array` of `string` | no | Globals the `vars` section reads, as `s_sel`, `main.c::s_sel` or `s_ok[2]`. Required by `vars`, refused without it. |
| `what` | `<what>` | `array` of `"tasks"` \| `"heap"` \| `"nvs"` \| `"lvgl"` \| `"vars"` \| `"fidelity"` | yes | Sections to report. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/inspect.input.json`](../schema/commands/inspect.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/inspect.output.json`](../schema/commands/inspect.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/inspect.d.ts` (`InspectArgs`, `InspectResult`).

## Errors

| Code | Number |
|---|---|
| `E_USAGE` | 1 |
| `E_STATE` | 2 |
| `E_LEASE` | 6 |
| `E_SECRET_REFUSED` | 16 |
| `E_INTERNAL` | 17 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Read the task table

```sh
passportsim inspect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "what": [
    "tasks"
  ]
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "what": [
    "tasks"
  ]
}
'@ | passportsim inspect --json -
```

### Read the heap and the LVGL object counts together

```sh
passportsim inspect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "what": [
    "heap",
    "lvgl"
  ]
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "what": [
    "heap",
    "lvgl"
  ]
}
'@ | passportsim inspect --json -
```

### List the NVS namespaces and keys, never their credential values

```sh
passportsim inspect --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "what": [
    "nvs"
  ]
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "what": [
    "nvs"
  ]
}
'@ | passportsim inspect --json -
```
